evidence.summary: Per-task FAILED state and error code remain inspectable independently from CANCELLED state.
ScopeRun preserves ordered outputs, each failure reason, cancellation count, cleanup count, and deterministic first_failure.
Forge native transition integration is still in progress; bounded host collections remain the temporary state container.

reproduction.instructions: Revalidate against the current Profile 0.18 source/runtime and exact focused Forge reproducer.

summary: scope.v1 records each task failure distinctly from cancellation; TaskScope returns every per-index result and a deterministic first-failure index. Forge continuous execution still makes pending/defer decisions in its consumer loop, which this campaign is migrating to the native Forge core.

workaround.description: Forge continues to use the existing bounded host Runner for process realization while native semantic migration proceeds.
